fire:
In the winter of that year the
village council agreed to build
a new school near the river.

My grandfather always told us that
the old mill had burned down twice.

The committee has asked the
members to vote before the end of
the month.

Several readers wrote in to say that
the review was unfair to the author.

Most of the soldiers in the
regiment had never seen the sea.

We were told by the guide that
the path was closed for repairs.

During the long service the
children sat quietly in the back.

The report claims that the
city spent too much on the bridge.
quiet: In the winter of that year the village council agreed to build a new school near the river.
My grandfather always told us that the old mill had burned down twice.

The committee has asked the members to vote.
The deadline is the end of the month.
Several readers wrote in to say that the review was unfair to the author.

Most of the soldiers had never seen the sea.
The regiment came from the hills.
We were told by the guide that the path was closed for repairs.

The service was long.
The children sat quietly in the back.
The report claims that the city spent too much on the bridge.
